keyVerseDR: "This is my most beloved Son. Hear ye him." (Mk 9:6 DR)

level1.title: Jesus Shines
level1.story: Jesus went up a mountain with Peter, James, and John. His clothes became shining white! A voice said, "This is My Son. Listen to Him!"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you listen to Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me listen to You. Amen.

activity.title: Shining like light
activity.intro: Color the stained-glass window of the Transfiguration.

level2.title: The Transfiguration
level2.story: Jesus took Peter, James, and John up a high mountain alone. He was transfigured before them, and His garments became shining and exceeding white as snow. Elijah and Moses appeared, talking with Jesus. Peter said, "Rabbi, it is good for us to be here: let us make three tabernacles." A cloud overshadowed them, and a voice said, "This is My most beloved Son; hear ye Him."
level2.keyLine: This is my most beloved Son. Hear ye him.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did Peter want to build tents?
How does this glory help us during Lent?
level2.prayer: Jesus, let me see Your glory and listen. Amen.

activity.title: Say it in one line
activity.intro: Think about the Gospel, then open to read a summary.
activity.question: Can you tell today's Gospel in one sentence?
activity.answer: On the mountain Jesus shone with glory, and the Father said, "This is My beloved Son; hear Him."

art.mainBrief: Jesus in dazzling white on mountain, Elijah and Moses
art.heartBrief: Sun rays radiating from heart; cloud at top
